text:
inc-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-prod — metric p99_token_latency crossed 1200ms at 2026-03-15T10:08:19Z (ts 7532109999). Alert link: https://redwood.monitoring/alerts/INC-4521

pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-4521 created and routed to on-call (latency-critical). Escalation policy: latency-critical. Notifying @Samira.

Samira: ack — I'm taking this. Quick triage in flight.

Samira: TL;DR: p95 is ~400ms, p99 peaked ~1300ms. Error rate normal. KV cache miss rate is up and eviction spikes align with tail. Likely hotkey/backpressure.

Noah: seeing same on metrics. Hotkey churn in us-east, some unusually large batch requests from a few customers. Trying to repro locally.

Riley: if it's hotkeys + large batches, we should throttle large batches and warm the cache for top keys. Also consider routing very long inputs to async path.

Samira: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) throttle large-batch jobs (max_batch_size=8) 2) bump replicas for sidecars in us-east (fast scaling) 3) run cache-warm for top 50 hotkeys 4) add token-length rule to route long requests to async queue. Will coordinate steps.

Kai: I'll push the throttle change now. Command I'm running:
```
rdctl routing update --route inference-prod --max-batch-size 8 --ticket incident-7532
```
Pushing in ~90s.

pagerduty-bot: Alert auto-acknowledged by Samira.

OpsOnCall: noting customer-impact: real-time embeddings customers on shared endpoints may see reduced throughput while we throttle. CS/SEs notified to pause heavy workloads.

Riley: warming script ready:
```
python tools/warm_kv.py --env prod --region us-east --keys-file /tmp/top50.txt
```
I'll run after throttle is confirmed.

Noah: autoscaler shows GPUs are saturated on queue depth (not CPU). KV eviction rate high. Reroute to eu-west possible but prefer local mitigation first.

Samira: Kai, confirm throttle applied?

Kai: throttle config confirmed in config-service and propagated. Observability: p99 dropped from 1300ms -> ~900ms within 90s. Proceeding to run warm.

inc-bot: Job warm_kv.py started by Kai (job-id 0a9f). Estimated time ~3m.

Kai: warm_kv job finished — 50 keys warmed, success rate 98%. Logs: https://redwood.jobs/logs/0a9f

Kai: after warm, tail p99 is around 620ms (sampling on prod-dash).

Noah: still seeing a small tail for very long prompts (>1024 tokens). Suggest token-length rule to move those to async so short requests remain fast.

Samira: applying quick rule:
```
rdctl routing add-rule --route inference-prod --condition "input_tokens>1024" --target async-queue --ticket incident-7532
```
Applying now.

Kai: rule applied and propagated. Async queue acceptance looks healthy.

pagerduty-bot: Escalations suppressed for INC-4521; incident remains acknowledged and under investigation.

Samira: monitoring for next 15m to ensure stabilization. Current p99 ~630ms, trending down. If stable under 700ms and no new PD alerts, we'll resolve. @Noah @Riley prepare handoff notes for next on-call in 30m.

OpsOnCall: I'll update the incident page with timeline, customer impact, and mitigations: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-4521. Also notifying affected customers via internal CS thread.

Riley: added runbook steps we executed to the incident page: throttle large batches, warm_kv, add async token-length rule, consider cross-region reroute if reoccurs.

Samira: leaving incident in ack state. Handoff to Noah at 10:40Z. If anything regresses before then, re-open page. Great work all. :thumbsup:

Noah: Ack, I'll take the handoff and stay on for 40m. If we see spike >1000ms again, escalate to on-call lead and consider temporary cross-region reroute.

inc-bot: INC-4521 updated: status=acknowledged, handlers=[Samira, Noah], severity=page.

Samira: closing thread here — moving notes to incident doc and SLO postmortem checklist.

Noah: closing watch but I'll remain available.

(End of thread)
